assumptions: Coverage >=.95 must hold at every parameter value in the native box (uniform validity), not only at the registered design point; a procedure validated only at one design is not covered by the bound's premise but neither is it uniformly valid.
E_0 length = integral of P_0(t in C) dt (Fubini, measurable sets); P_0(t in C) >= .95 - TV(P_0^N, P_t^N) for any nuisance with that coordinate fixed.
TV <= min(Pinsker, sqrt(1-BC^(2N))) for N iid persons over 4096 patterns; non-optimal nuisance only weakens (bound stays valid).

Grid integration: trapezoid is not a strict lower bound; the lower-Riemann figure is a strict bound only if the integrand is monotone between grid points (holds empirically on the 32-point grid). Hence 'impossible below ~52k' is near-rigorous, not a formal proof.
